Execute the acquired semantic reading operations on the CURRENT
source windows. All operation meanings, alternatives and examples are learned
assets, not current-source facts. Classify the operation's actual question;
do not answer a downstream task or copy an old example's choice. Preserve who
acts, the legal modality, trigger, scope and qualifications. A heading, mention
or hypothetical event is not automatically an operative duty or permission.
Return exactly one answer for every supplied query ID. Select a declared choice
or "unknown". Missing information is unknown, never an implicit negative.
Return {"answers": {query_id: {"choice": choice, "evidence_unit_ids": [unit_id]}}}.
Select the IDs of the current supplied units that support your classification.
The host retrieves those units exactly. Do not copy, rewrite or repair quotes.
Select all units needed to resolve actors, conditions and cross-references.
Every definite classification needs supporting units. Only an explicitly
declared alternative meaning absence after inspecting the complete supplied
source may have no supporting unit. Unknown may have no evidence. Demonstration
quotes belong to their original sources, never the current source. No extra IDs
or fields. Selecting a unit does not make its interpretation automatically true.
The focus_unit_id identifies the clause to classify. Other supplied units are context for resolving its references, not additional effects to merge into that focus. Interpret the acquired operation for that focus clause, using its actual context.

Neither party shall disclose the Confidential Information received from the other to any person or entity, except its employees, officers, directors, independent consultants, affiliates, subsidiaries and other agents (collectively “Representatives”) involved in the performance of the Project, or to use the Confidential Information for any purpose other than fulfilling its obligations under the Project.”"}], "current_queries": [{"id": "disclosure_roles_17", "operation": "disclosure_recipient_profile_v1", "unit_ids": [13, 14, 15, 16, 17], "current_units": [{"id": 13, "text": "The divisions or subsidiaries are part of the Business."}, {"id": 14, "text": "The information furnished to us or our representatives, together with analyses, compilations, forecasts, studies or other documents prepared by us, our agents, representatives (including attorneys, accountants and financial advisors) or employees which contain or otherwise reflect such information or our review of, or interest in, the Business, is hereinafter referred to as the \"Information.\""}, {"id": 15, "text": "In consideration of your furnishing us with the Information, we agree that:"}, {"id": 16, "text": "1. The Information will be kept confidential and shall not without your prior written consent, be disclosed by us, or by our agents, representatives or employees, in any manner whatsover, in whole or in part, and shall not be used by us, our agents, representatives or employees, other than in connection with the transaction described above."}, {"id": 17, "text": "Moreover, we agree to reveal the Information only to our agents, representatives and employees who need to know the Information for the purpose of evaluating the transaction described above, who are informed by us of the confidential nature of the Information and who shall agree in writing to act in accordance with the terms and conditions of this Agreement."}], "focus_unit_id": 17}]}
